services.name: Sound Teacher Training
services.desc: Whether you're just beginning your sound healing journey or looking to deepen your existing practice, this 2 day, in-person Certification Course is a comprehensive training designed to help you confidently facilitate meaningful group sound experiences. This certification goes beyond simply learning instruments. You'll gain a deeper understanding of how sound influences the nervous system, how to create intentional sound journeys, and how to confidently guide groups through experiences that encourage relaxation, connection, reflection, and wellbeing. Throughout this immersive two-day training, you'll explore the foundations of sound and vibration, nervous system and brainwave education,

services.name: Reiki Certification
services.desc: Has your journey called to you to integrate Reiki Healing into your life? This special package for all three levels of Reiki Certification will allow you to enroll in all 3 levels and also receive a special gift from teachers Paula and Jean-Luc Casano of Sana Sana Studio. They are offering students who commit to enroll in Levels 1-3 (which can be scheduled within our ongoing sessions that work best for your schedule) the opportunity to fully experience the gentle healing and balance this beautiful modality offers as a way to fully welcome you into your own Reiki journey. To take advantage of this special offering when booking Level I, please select the package purchase option at check out
